summary: Implemented parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError in rdflib/extras/shacl.py, with tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (41 passed) under the shared venv. Nothing committed; no existing files touched. Mypy and black are not installed in the shared venv, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading only. Choices: non-node guard re-binds the argument as object so None is not treated as a wildcard and warn_unreachable stays quiet; type-ignores sit on the reported argument line; modifiers use explicit MulPath branches with literal "*", "+", "?"; extra tests cover non-node inputs and graph immutability.
